stemMd: The proposal is not impractical merely because it has never been tried here. Similar towns have implemented it successfully, and our budget is at least as large as theirs. Therefore the council should assess the proposal on its requirements rather than dismiss it as unprecedented. The successful towns are cited to

explanationMd: The examples serve as counterevidence to the claim that novelty itself makes the plan impractical. They do not prove guaranteed success locally; they support evaluating the actual requirements instead of rejecting it solely for being new.

distractorRationale.a: Success elsewhere does not establish exclusivity.
distractorRationale.b: The argument favors considering an untried local proposal.
